newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Sievert - unclear if rates have bottomed out.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Sievert - unclear if rates have bottomed out.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Tuesday the Bundesbank saw no need at present to change interest rates but added that it remained to be seen whether the rate cut cycle had bottomed out.
"At present we see no cause to consider a change in our interest rates," Sievert said according to the text of a speech to be delivered at a conference.
"Whether we have already reached the end of the road, as some believe, remains to be seen. I myself do not yet want to subscribe to such a forecast."
